scope.read_only: This member is outside your current editing context. Change account access before preparing a change.

members.title: Members
members.empty: No members are available in this view.
members.roles_unavailable: Role choices are not available with your current access. Existing assignments are preserved.
members.roles_unknown: Some existing role labels are unavailable. Existing assignments are preserved.
members.prepared: Roles assigned while suspended take effect only if this membership becomes active.
members.revoke_hint: Revoking ends this membership permanently. It cannot be reactivated from this page.
members.suspend_hint: Suspension pauses access while preserving the membership and its assignments.

roles.title: Roles
roles.read_only: You can view this role. Editing requires eligible institution-wide access.
roles.adopt_hint: This adds the listed permissions to this role. Previously removed permissions are not restored.
roles.release_current: No release adoption is available for this role.

permissions.settings: Manage institution appearance and invitation lifetime

failure.title: This view is unavailable
failure.denied: This view is not available with your current account access.
failure.not_found: This item is no longer available in this view.
failure.invalid_cursor: This page link is no longer valid. Start from the first page.
failure.unavailable: This view could not be checked. Try again when you are ready.
failure.busy: Too many requests are in progress. Wait before trying again.
failure.retry_after: Seconds to wait before trying again

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.create_hint: Send an invitation to this institution or branch with one offered role. Email is sent automatically.
invitations.email_hint: Use the email address the person will verify on their account.
invitations.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address: ASCII characters only, one @, and no spaces or consecutive dots.
invitations.invalid_role: No offered role was submitted. Return to the invitations page and choose a role.
invitations.role_kept: The role you chose is kept and is sent again with this form.
invitations.no_roles: No roles are currently available to offer with your access.
invitations.empty: No invitations are available in this view.
invitations.submission_accepted: Submission accepted by the mail server
invitations.delivery_hint: Mail server acceptance does not confirm inbox delivery or that the email was read.
invitations.uncertain_hint: The email may still arrive. Unfinished work continues to use delivery capacity; an unknown result is not a confirmed failure.
invitations.already_member: The person already had an active membership. Their existing roles and profile were preserved; the offered role was not added.
invitations.created_member: A new membership was created with the offered role.
invitations.role_unavailable: Offered role label is no longer available with your access.
invitations.role_changed: The offered role is no longer available with its original version. Revoke this offer and create a new invitation to choose the current role.
invitations.other_scope: This invitation is outside your current access context. Change account access to manage it.
invitations.reissue_hint: This replaces the current code and expiry. An older email can still arrive, but its code will no longer work. Unfinished earlier email work retains its delivery slot.
invitations.revoke_hint: This ends the offer. An email already in progress may still arrive, but it cannot grant membership.
invitations.policy_hint: Choose the lifetime for future invitations and explicit replacements. Existing invitation expiry times stay unchanged.
invitations.policy_stored: This institution has a saved lifetime policy.
invitations.policy_default: No policy has been saved. The default lifetime is 14 days.
invitations.policy_range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
invitations.policy_read_only: You can view this policy. Editing requires institution-wide settings permission.

data_requests.title: Data requests
data_requests.intro: Requests to export or erase the data of members in your current access, newest first. You see each request's status and counts, never the data itself.
data_requests.no_download: An exported file is available only to the person it concerns, on their own data page. Administrators cannot download it.
data_requests.no_closure: An account closure is the person's own request and is not shown here.
data_requests.from_member: To ask for an export, open the member's page. To ask for an erasure, revoke the membership on the member's page first; the page where its erasure is asked for then opens.
data_requests.scope_tenant: These are the requests about institution memberships. Requests about a branch membership are made and shown in that branch's access.
data_requests.scope_organization: These are the requests about memberships in your current branch.
data_requests.empty: No data requests have been made in this scope.
data_requests.memberships_note: This request covers more than one membership record of this person in this scope:
data_requests.memberships_more: Only the first 20 records are listed.

next.export_requested: The export is being prepared. This usually takes a few minutes.
next.export_ready: The file is ready. The person can download it on their own data page until the date shown.
next.export_gone: The file can no longer be downloaded.
next.erasure_scheduled: Erasure starts after the time shown. Until then the person can cancel it, and so can the administrator who asked for it.
next.erasure_scheduled_self: Erasure starts after the time shown. Until then the person can cancel it.
next.erasure_fulfilling: The member's data in this scope is being erased.
next.erasure_awaiting: The member's data in this scope has been erased. An operator now completes the last step on the activity records.

last_refusal.blocked_window: An operator tried to begin before the waiting time had ended.
last_refusal.blocked_hold: It stopped because the institution has to keep this person's data for now, for example for an open payment matter.
last_refusal.blocked_last_administrator: It stopped because this person is the institution's only administrator. Once another administrator is appointed, a new erasure can be requested.

failure.export_too_large: The person's data was too large for one file, so the export failed. Ask the platform operator about the export size limit.

retained.consent_evidence: Records of consents the person gave or withdrew
retained.invitation_record: Records of invitations the person sent or accepted
retained.audit_actor_reference: Activity records of things the person did
retained.audit_entity_reference: Activity records about the person's membership
retained.audit_metadata_reference: Activity records that mention the person
retained.federation_actor_reference: Records of single sign-on set-up steps the person took
retained.unserved_group: Places that could not be processed and keep the person's data for now

refusal.request_already_active: A request of this kind is already in progress for this member in this scope. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it if you asked for it.
refusal.subject_membership_current: This person still has an active or suspended membership in this scope. Their data can be erased only once that membership is revoked.
refusal.blocked_hold: This cannot go ahead right now because the institution has to keep this member's data for the moment, for example for an open payment matter.
refusal.blocked_last_administrator: This member is the institution's only administrator. Appoint another administrator before asking for an erasure.
refusal.snapshot_too_large: This person has more membership records in this scope than one request can hold. Ask the platform operator for help.
refusal.subject_not_admitted: This person's account is being closed, so no new request can be made about them.
refusal.data_export_unavailable: This file is no longer available, so there is nothing to delete.
refusal.unknown: This request was refused. Check its current state before trying again.

result.export: The export was requested. The file is usually ready within minutes and is then available to the person on their own data page.
result.erasure: The erasure was requested. It starts after 24 hours; until then you or the person can cancel it.
result.revoked: The file has been deleted. Nobody can download it any more.

member.intro: Requests about this member's data in your current access. You see their status, never the data.
member.other_scope: Data requests about this member are made in the member's own scope. Change account access to that scope to see or make them.
member.none: No data requests about this member have been made in this scope.
member.unavailable: This member's data requests could not be checked just now. The forms below still work, and every request is checked when it is made.
member.partial: Only the 100 most recent requests of this scope were checked for this member. Older ones are on the data requests page.

export.title: Export this member's data
export.description: Prepares one file with the data this institution holds about the person in this scope: their membership and profile, their answers and consents, their invitations and the activity records about them in this scope. The file is available only to the person, on their own data page, for 7 days. You see its status and size, never its content.
export.replaces: An export cannot be requested while the person still has a file to download, because a new export would delete it.
export.active: An export for this member is already being prepared.

erasure.title: Erase this member's data
erasure.summary: Erasure clears the person's profile and answers in this scope and removes their roles here. Their account and their memberships elsewhere stay as they are.
erasure.revoke_first: Revoke it in Membership access first. The revocation is recorded as its own action, and the page where its erasure is asked for then opens.
erasure.erased_profile: The person's name, language and the answers they gave in this scope are cleared.
erasure.erased_roles: Their roles in this scope are removed. The revoked membership stays as an empty record.
erasure.erased_exports: Copies of their data that can still be downloaded are deleted, and a copy still being prepared is cancelled.
erasure.erased_invitations: Invitations they sent in this scope that nobody has accepted yet are withdrawn.
erasure.kept_intro: Some records have to be kept. They no longer hold the person's name or answers, but they still refer to the person by an internal number:
erasure.kept_consent: the record of the consents they gave or withdrew, kept as evidence;
erasure.kept_invitations: the record of invitations they sent or accepted, including the e-mail address an invitation was sent to;
erasure.kept_audit: activity records: after the erasure, an operator removes network addresses, browser details and e-mail addresses from the activity records about the person in this scope, including records of what administrators did about them here. Records of what the person did in other branches or at institution level are not changed by this request;
erasure.kept_attribution: notes of who created or last changed something here;
erasure.timing: Erasure starts 24 hours after you request it. Until then the person can cancel it on their own data page, and you can cancel it on the request's page. If the person is admitted to this scope again within those 24 hours, the erasure still runs.
erasure.confirm: I understand what is erased and what is kept, and that erasure cannot be undone once it starts.

erasure_page.title: Erase a revoked member's data
erasure_page.revoked: This page asks for the erasure of the membership named below. A revoked membership is no longer listed among the members and has no member page.
erasure_page.only_revoked: An erasure can be asked for only while the person has no active or suspended membership in this scope. Otherwise the request is refused and nothing changes.
erasure_page.missing: No membership was named. This page opens for a membership right after it is revoked.

cancel.hint: Cancelling ends the request. Nothing about the member changes.
cancel.other: Another administrator asked for this request. Only they or the person can cancel it.
cancel.person: The person asked for this request themselves. Only they can cancel it.

revoke.title: Delete the exported file
revoke.hint: Once deleted, nobody can download the file any more, including the person. The request stays as a record.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.label: Field label
custom_fields.unsupported: This shape is unsupported. No answer can be submitted.
custom_fields.immutable: Published revisions are immutable. A successor never converts existing answers or transfers consent.
custom_fields.publish_hint: Publishing replaces the active revision linked below. Existing answers retain their original revision.
custom_fields.capacity: Limits: 20 active fields, 20 live drafts, 100 permanent keys and 1,000 retained revisions. Discarding releases only a draft slot.
custom_fields.input_budget: Authoring input must fit 4 KiB, including the schema (2 KiB), labels and notices. The encoded request must fit 16 KiB.
custom_fields.withheld: Answer withheld because current consent is absent.
custom_fields.incomplete: Missing required answers leave this form incomplete. Your account access is unaffected.
custom_fields.remove_hint: Removal works independently of required answers and consent. Withdrawal hides a value; removal clears it.
custom_fields.numeric_hint: Use decimal or exponent notation. Whole numbers must be within ±9,007,199,254,740,991. Overflow, lost integer precision and nonzero underflow are rejected.
custom_fields.value_budget: One submission: 4 KiB. Retained answers: 20 slots and 32 KiB, including historical revisions. Optional answers may be saved separately after required answers are complete.
custom_fields.consent_hint: Giving consent and saving an answer are separate acts. Consent alone does not save any answer. You may decline without losing existing access.
custom_fields.grant: Give consent to this exact notice
custom_fields.consent_history_incomplete: Consent history for this membership has not yet been checked.
custom_fields.consent_history_continue: Check this membership’s consent history and withdrawal
custom_fields.no_consents: No consent records on this page.
custom_fields.retained_entry: Manage retained consent, including former memberships
custom_fields.admin_consent: Only this person can give personal consent. An administrator cannot grant it on their behalf.
custom_fields.no_js_builder: Without JavaScript, this form edits text, whole numbers, numbers and yes/no fields. Enable JavaScript to use the prefilled visual editor for choices and nested fields.
custom_fields.advanced_hint: Only the supported finite profile is accepted. Labels are literal text, never HTML.
custom_fields.errors: Check the field key, explicit category, labels, bounds and byte limits. No change has been submitted.
custom_fields.no_js_answers: Answer groups and lists without JavaScript
custom_fields.no_js_answers_hint: Choose how many list items to include, then complete only the first that many items. For an optional answer, choose Yes to include it or No to leave it out. Other list items and excluded optional answers are ignored. Nothing is saved until you submit.
custom_fields.disabled_translations_hint: This save includes only enabled institution languages. Disabled translations are not carried into the draft; published revisions keep their original translations. Enter the label and any sensitive-data notice in the current default language.
custom_fields.required_first: Complete the missing required answers first. You can then edit other answers separately. Removing a retained answer remains available.
custom_fields.recovery_unavailable: This list shows nonempty input from your rejected request. Field details could not be reloaded for editing. Open the current view before preparing another change.
custom_fields.author_text_hint: Normal text saves new lines as line feeds. Exact line endings preserves carriage returns with \r, line feeds with \n, and backslashes with \\. Existing line endings are preserved. To use Normal text, first replace any \r escapes deliberately. Limits apply to the decoded text.
custom_fields.text_entry_hint: Normal text saves new lines as line feeds. Exact line endings uses \r for a carriage return, \n for a line feed, and \\ for a backslash. It preserves existing line endings. To use Normal text, first replace any \r escapes deliberately. Length limits count the decoded answer.
custom_fields.scalar_editor_unavailable: This revision uses choices or nested answers. Its prefilled visual editor above preserves the complete field; enable JavaScript to edit it.

federation.title: Single sign-on
federation.intro: Let people sign in through your organization's identity provider with an account they already have here.
federation.explain_link: Single sign-on links an existing account; it never creates one. Once a person links their account, whoever controls your identity provider can sign in as that person, here and in any other institution the person belongs to.
federation.explain_test: The test signs you in through your identity provider as yourself, links your own account to it if it is not linked yet, and then signs you out. Sign in again afterwards to continue.
federation.explain_disable: Disable and Delete stop sign-in through your identity provider and end sessions that started through it. They do not remove passwords or one-time codes that were added to an account during such a session.
federation.display_name: Name shown on the sign-in page
federation.display_name_hint: Shown on the sign-in button. Up to 80 characters.
federation.pending_title: A change is waiting for confirmation
federation.pending: The last change has not been confirmed yet. You can resume it after the waiting period.
federation.drift: The sign-in service holds a configuration that differs from the one saved here. Save the configuration again and test it.
federation.unavailable: The sign-in service could not be checked just now. The status shown may be out of date.
federation.configure_note: Saving a changed configuration requires a new test before single sign-on can be active again.
federation.url_hint: An https address of your identity provider.
federation.certificate_1: Signing certificate in PEM format (manual entry)
federation.certificate_2: Second signing certificate in PEM format (optional)
federation.client_secret_hint: Write-only: a stored secret is never shown. Required the first time and whenever the endpoints or client change.
federation.values_hint: Copy these values into your identity provider.
federation.redirect_uri: Redirect URI (OpenID Connect) or Assertion Consumer Service URL (SAML)
federation.values_unavailable: These values appear after the first configuration is saved.
federation.rotate_note: A new secret returns single sign-on to Not tested; test again before activating.
federation.test_hint: Before the test, make sure your identity provider uses the values above and that your own account here uses the same email address as at your identity provider.
federation.test_open: A test window is open for up to 10 minutes, and you must finish signing in through your identity provider within 5 minutes of starting the test. If the test was interrupted, wait for the window to close and start again.
federation.test_needs_draft: Save a configuration to start a test.
federation.activate_note: Activation shows the sign-in button on your sign-in page.
federation.activate_needs_test: Activation becomes available after a passed test.
federation.confirm_disable: I understand that sign-in through the identity provider stops and its sessions end.
federation.enable_note: Enabling again requires a new test.
federation.delete_note: Deleting removes this identity provider and the account links to it. A new configuration gets new values for your identity provider.
federation.confirm_delete: I understand that this identity provider and its account links are deleted.
